info.name: Call 1 Ingest · Call 2 Recommend · Call 3 Q&A
info.description:
Postman collection for haystack-fast-api multi-call journey (as-built):

1) **Call 1** `POST /internal/v1/recommendations/submitprojectspecification`
   — dual-branch indexing + mandatory KG-1 (internal) + **lean FR-IX-023** public body
2) **Call 2** `POST /internal/v1/recommendations/project-knowledge/getassetrecommendations`
   — **recommend / quote** (`quoteRef`, `items[]`, `confidenceScore`, `mlPredictedPrice`)
3) **Call 3** `POST /internal/v1/recommendations/project-knowledge/query`
   — **chatbot Q&A** (`answer`, hits, `tool_traces`)

**Import:** this collection + environment `Indexing-Pipeline-Local`.

**Server:** from `haystack-fast-api/`:
```
uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload
```

**Portal saga:** Call 1 then Call 2 (save `ingestId`). React primary body = Call 2 quote.
Call 3 is optional follow-up on the same process-local session.

**Call 1 public body (lean):** `ingest_id`, `user_id`, `user_requirement_summary`,
`tentative_start_date`/`end_date`, `needs_summary[]`, `expected_budget`, `warnings[]`.
Technical fields (`data_kind`, `documents_written`, `kg_built`, `documents[]`) are **not** on the public response (session/meta only).

**Headers:** `Idempotency-Key` (Call 1 only), `X-Correlation-Id`, optional `traceparent`.

**Env notes:**
- CI/local fake: `FLEET_BACKEND=fake`, `RECOMMEND_VIA_AGENT_GRAPH=false`, mock embedder
- Live compose: `FLEET_BACKEND=sql` → `equipment.id` = `assets.id`; optional `RECOMMEND_VIA_AGENT_GRAPH=true`

**Docs:** `docs/call1-call2-endpoint-process.md` · `docs/multi-agent-architecture.md` · `postman/README.md`
